decision_rule.statement: For a future determination v +/- s of 1/alpha(0) with its own quoted standard uncertainty (no expansion factor): |c - v| <= 2s consistent; 2s < |c - v| <= 3s tension; |c - v| > 3s excluded by that determination. For a CODATA adjustment, report both the expanded and the unexpanded comparison.
decision_rule.decisive_case: A new cesium-type result agreeing with Berkeley 2018 would exclude the candidate at about 5 sigma; agreement of new g-2 and rubidium results near the candidate would support it at the next digit.

B_same_arithmetic_elsewhere.label: Heuristic: our evaluation of the Letter's arithmetic outside its stated scope. NOT claims of the author. Registered to make any later identification checkable for post-hoc fitting.
